tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default email background (cream). Ink text on it.

tokens.name: surface-white
tokens.usage: Image placeholders, white panels and product-card grounds. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: surface-linen
tokens.usage: Slightly warmer panel ground for Support bar value props. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body and headline text on light grounds; fill for dark modules, buttons, pre-header and footer. Text on surface, surface-white, surface-linen and banner-mist.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text, icons and dotted rules on ink-filled modules (dark Reviews, dark Footer, pre-header, buttons).

tokens.name: banner-mist
tokens.usage: Blue-grey SMS / promo banner under the Support bar. Ink text on it.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above headlines and subheaders (set text-transform: uppercase).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight vertical padding between stacked text rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related text; pre-header vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a product image and its text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Email side gutter and column gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, module vertical padding.

layout.note: Email canvas widths from the Figma templates.
